text_block_list.text:
One day, Royce and Royce was engrossed in
a co-op action game with her friends.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
—Royce, watch out!
Special move: Turbo Break! Woooaaah!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the save, Turbo-san.
I never thought you'd step in to cover for me.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehe! Turbo is the strongest, so
of course this is a piece of cake—Aaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Geez, that's what happens when you drop your guard!
I'll draw the enemies, so heal up in the meantime.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, to sacrifice oneself to save a friend,
what a noble sacrificio!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Charging bravely ahead despite being battered and bruised, she is a true hero! How truly commovente!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I dedicate this to all of you. Resonate! Rhapsody of the Soul!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I still have no idea what she's saying as usual,
but she sure knows how to buff us at the right time.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Another monster from over there!
Turbo will go chase it off!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Hmm, Turbo-san has an image of being utterly reckless,
but unexpectedly, she's actually paying good attention to her surroundings.)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (Nature-san is surprisingly leader-like. Earth-san provides precise support and is quite devoted, isn't she...)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (The harmonious atmosphere blended with just the right amount of tension brings out unexpected styles in everyone.)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I'm so glad I invited everyone after all♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Something about it just bugs me whenever Royce makes that kind of face.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "Geez, that's not true! Royce is just having fun playing games with everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, let's just go with that. Turbo looks like she's about to be blown away soon, so go back her up, will you?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay♪ Hehe,
Nature-san really is kind deep down, isn't she?♪

Never failing to read the personalities of those around her through every possible means,
Royce and Royce applied her keen observation skills to racing tactics as well.
